# HCAI Symposium 2025 — OVGU Magdeburg

> The Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence Symposium Series (HCAI@OVGU) brings together experts from academia and industry to discuss key topics like Responsible AI, Explainable AI, Fairness, and Human-Centred AI approaches. Organized by the Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence Research Group at Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg.

## Event Overview

**Event Name**: HCAI Symposium 2025
**Host Institution**: Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg (OVGU)
**Faculty**: Faculty of Computer Science
**Location**: Magdeburg, Germany
**Website**: https://hcai-ovgu.github.io/symposium2025/
**Status**: Upcoming event (2025)

### 4. Knut Polkehn
- **Affiliation**: Consultant at artop – Institut an der Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin

- **Specialization**: User research, conceptual design, usability evaluation, UXQB certification system
- **Website**: https://www.artop.de/en/team/knut-polkehn/

### 5. Prof. Dr. Michael Bosnjak
- **Title**: Professor and Head of Department

- **Expertise**: Research synthesis methods, AI-based inference methods, survey methodology, open science

- **Notable Role**: Editor-in-Chief of Zeitschrift für Psychologie (oldest Psychology journal in Europe, founded 1890)
- **Previous Positions**: Director of Leibniz Institute for Psychology (ZPID), Scientific Director at Robert Koch Institute

## Research Focus Areas

The symposium covers these key topics:
- **Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence**: Core focus on human-AI interaction
- **Responsible Artificial Intelligence**: Ethical AI development and deployment
- **Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)**: Transparent and interpretable AI systems
- **Biases and Fairness**: Addressing algorithmic bias and promoting fairness
- **Legal AI and Regulations**: AI governance, compliance, and regulatory frameworks
- **Personalised User Interfaces**: Adaptive and user-centric interface design
- **Information Ethics**: Ethical considerations in information processing and AI
- **Privacy and Safety**: Data protection and AI system safety
